note: Every shape is an absolute path (M, L, Q, C, Z) in its own coordinates, drawn in list order: apply m = [a, b, c, d, e, f] to the canvas (absent = identity), fill first, then stroke. Colors are #RRGGBB; null draws nothing. Opacity fields are absent when 1.

idle.formula: s = sin(2*pi*t/periodMs); scale(1 + scaleX*s, 1 + scaleY*s) about the anchor
